mostWorthwhile.text: Checking both radios against their measured loads and reserve capacities was worthwhile: it turned an assumed overnight link into a specific, bounded claim with a recheck planned.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the meter twice before it became available was frustrating, especially as the running link seemed ready to measure.

surprise.text: The meter remained unavailable until the solar charging pair was fitted, even though the panels could add no energy that night.

arbitrary.text: Requiring the solar inputs before the overnight load check felt arbitrary from the information available; I couldn't see why measuring the powered radios depended on them.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the neighborhoods make their networks understand each other, especially after establishing a working local link.
